## INCIDENT REPORT: Malware Infection - MTA 2021-09-10

**Incident Summary:**
Workstation DESKTOP-KKITB6Q (10.9.10.102) belonging to user hobart.gunnarsson was compromised on 2021-09-11. The host downloaded a 64-bit Windows DLL trojan from the malicious domain simpsonsavingss.com and initiated repeated C2 beaconing to 94.158.245.52:443. The infection pattern (second-stage payload delivery, persistent C2 callbacks) is consistent with a banking trojan, likely Ursnif/Gozi based on behavioral indicators.

**Victim Host:**
- IPv4 Address: 10.9.10.102
- MAC Address: 00:4f:49:b1:e8:c3
- Hostname: DESKTOP-KKITB6Q
- Logged-in User: hobart.gunnarsson
- Domain: angrypoutine.com

**Malware Family:**
Ursnif/Gozi banking trojan (attribution: behavioral; DLL-based second-stage loader, HTTPS C2 beaconing, DNS tunneling)

6. Audit domain-joined hosts (10.9.10.9, ANGRYPOUTINE-DC) for lateral movement via SMB
